scope: Exact additive mean client-TTFT host boundaries. This does not decompose TTFT p95. Prepare is a host boundary,not a GPU kernel start. C3 service enclosures can include worker queues and interleaved requests. Source-window occupancy is separate from GPU batch,KV credit and hidden-pool state. A stage delta locates latency. It does not isolate a GPU operator or prove one admission mechanism. A C0 Native run can appear under several cuts. Reused rows are not additional independent server starts.
